fullPassage: When scientists make an important new discovery or experimentally prove some hypothesis, they do not, in general, keep that information to themselves so that they alone can consider its meaning and derive additional theories from it. Instead, they publish their results and make their data available for inspection. This makes it possible for other scientists to reconsider their data and possibly refute their conclusions. More important, though, it makes it possible for other scientists to use that data to construct new hypotheses and perform new experiments. The assumption is that society as a whole will end up knowing more if information is spread as widely as possible, rather than being limited to a few people. In a strict sense, every scientist depends on the work of other scientists.

✅ ① 공유 → 사회 이익: 본문 핵심 요지 ← 정답
❌ ② 비밀 유지: 반대 (publish 강조)
❌ ③ 결론 불변: 반대 (refute 가능)
❌ ④ 소수만 발견: 본문 내용 아님
det.tip: society will end up knowing more if information is spread

ch: 과학 지식은 공유될 때 사회 전체에 더 큰 이익을 준다.
과학자들은 자신의 연구를 보호하기 위해 비밀을 유지해야 한다.
과학적 결론은 한 번 내려지면 변경할 수 없다.
소수의 과학자만이 중요한 발견을 할 수 있다.

questions.passage: When scientists make an important new discovery or experimentally prove some hypothesis, they do not, in general, keep that information to themselves so that they alone can consider its meaning and derive additional theories from it. Instead, they publish their results and make their data available for inspection. This makes it possible for other scientists to reconsider their data and possibly refute their conclusions. More important, though, it makes it possible for other scientists to use that data to construct new hypotheses and perform new experiments. The assumption is that __________ if information is spread as widely as possible, rather than being limited to a few people. In a strict sense, every scientist depends on the work of other scientists.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 빈칸을 완성하시오. (9단어) (영어로)
"사회 전체가 결국 더 많이 알게 될 것이다"
[조건] (1) society, as, a, whole, will, end, up, knowing, more를 모두 사용
(2) 정확히 9단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: society as a whole will end up knowing more
det.analysis: society as a whole will end up knowing more = 사회 전체가 결국 더 많이 알게 될 것이다. 9단어.
det.tip: end up V-ing = 결국 ~하게 되다, as a whole = 전체적으로
